svg.title: Predictions
svg.desc: Before each life, your Trenchie predicts how many KOs it will get. BEFORE THE LIFE 1+ 2+ 3+ 4+ 2+ Prediction locked 3 KOs Life ends AFTER THE LIFE Correct 3 KOs, predicted 2+ Public record Rarer calls earn more. You can add 0.01 testnet NEAR to a life. A miss goes on the record as a failure.
